scope: Complete static read of this exact reader, limited to historical-source/artifact identity, false success, output and secret boundaries. No source, tests, compiler, or archived program execution.
observed_controls: Fixed two artifact IDs, original successful run attempt 1 and original source/tree/job/runner/test-step metadata are bound before success.

Four fixed source paths are fetched and compared by size, Git blob and SHA256; AST inventory requires exactly 23 unique unittest methods. The original log requires each expected identity once, a single matching count and terminal OK, with no skipped or unexpected log line.

API redirects are disabled for the authenticated request. Artifact download uses a new request without Authorization; redirects require HTTPS. No signed URL, response body or arbitrary exception text is printed.
ZIP is restricted to exactly compilers.txt and tests.log, ordinary unencrypted stored/deflated members; decoded payload reaches EOF/CRC, is never extracted, imported or executed.
The complete derived report is serialized and checked against 128 KiB before output creation. Original compiler text is projected to numeric versions and recorded hash values.
limits: 64 KiB compressed and 256 KiB decoded budgets count returned payload; oversize detection can read one extra byte before rejection. These are not RSS or decoder-internal allocation limits.
ZIP central-directory parsing precedes the exact two-member rejection, under the already-checked small compressed archive bound.
Recorded compiler binary SHA256 is not a new hash of compiler executables; the report explicitly marks reexecution/rehashing false.

Original source checking covers the four named paths and test inventory, not all transitive compiler inputs or all project qualification. Explicit HIA/HCSN/production/library-clearance flags remain false.
qualification: Static review does not replace the pending actual reader controls, original archive readback, or any new native acceptance.
